A gas undergoes a thermodynamic cycle consisting of three processes beginning at an 10   
initial state where p=1.2 bar, $\mathrm { v } _ { 1 } = 1 . \dot { 6 } m ^ { 3 }$ and U=520 KJ. The processes are as follows:   
i) Process 1-2: compression with PV=constant to p₂=2 bar and U₂=690 KJ, ii) Process 2-   
3: W₂₃=0 KJ and O2₃=-150 KJ, and iii) Process 3-1: W₃1=50 KJ. Neglecting KE and PE   
changes, determine the heat interactions Q12 and Q31.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
